## Builds the six car models out of lofted bodies and primitives. Forward is -Z, ground at y = 0.

const Mk = preload("res://scripts/mk.gd")
const BuggyHQ = preload("res://scripts/buggy_hq.gd")
const CarsHQ = preload("res://scripts/cars_hq.gd")


static func paint_mat(col: Color, metal := 0.45, rough := 0.28) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.albedo_color = col
	m.metallic = metal
	m.roughness = rough
	m.metallic_specular = 0.7
	return m


static func glass_mat() -> StandardMaterial3D:
	return Mk.mat(Color(0.06, 0.09, 0.13), 0.06, 0.9, "glass")


static func trim() -> StandardMaterial3D:
	return Mk.mat(Color(0.07, 0.07, 0.08), 0.6, 0.2, "trim")


static func chrome() -> StandardMaterial3D:
	return Mk.mat(Color(0.85, 0.86, 0.88), 0.12, 1.0, "chrome")


## Returns {root, body, wheels:[{pivot, spin, pos, r, front}], brake: material, flames: [Node3D], half_len, half_w}
## hq: the player's car on HIGH graphics (full detail). mid: an AI car on HIGH graphics (lighter detailed model).
static func build(id: String, col: Color, hq := false, mid := false) -> Dictionary:
	if hq and id == "buggy":
		return BuggyHQ.build(col)
	if (hq or mid) and id != "buggy":
		var d := CarsHQ.build(id, col, hq)
		if not d.is_empty():
			return d
	var spec := {}
	match id:
		"patrol":
			spec = _patrol(col)
		"drifter":
			spec = _drifter(col)
		"muscle":
			spec = _muscle(col)
		"rally":
			spec = _rally(col)
		"falcon":
			spec = _falcon(col)
		_:
			spec = _buggy(col)
	var root := Node3D.new()
	var body := Node3D.new()
	root.add_child(body)
	var bm := MeshInstance3D.new()
	bm.mesh = Mk.combine(spec.parts)
	body.add_child(bm)
	# lights
	var head := Mk.emis(Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.8), 2.2)
	var brake := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	brake.albedo_color = Color(0.6, 0.02, 0.02)
	brake.emission_enabled = true
	brake.emission = Color(1.0, 0.05, 0.03)
	brake.emission_energy_multiplier = 0.8
	var lparts := []
	for hl in spec.head:
		lparts.append([hl[0], hl[1], head])
	for tl in spec.tail:
		lparts.append([tl[0], tl[1], brake])
	if not lparts.is_empty():
		var lm := MeshInstance3D.new()
		lm.mesh = Mk.combine(lparts)
		lm.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
		body.add_child(lm)
	# wheels
	var wheels := []
	var wr: float = spec.wr
	var wf: float = spec.get("wrf", wr)
	var wmesh := Mk.wheel_mesh(wr, spec.ww, spec.rim, spec.get("chunky", false))
	var wmesh_f := wmesh if is_equal_approx(wf, wr) else Mk.wheel_mesh(wf, spec.ww * 0.9, spec.rim, spec.get("chunky", false))
	for k in 4:
		var front := k < 2
		var side := -1.0 if k % 2 == 0 else 1.0
		var r := wf if front else wr
		var pos := Vector3(side * spec.track * 0.5, r, (-1.0 if front else 1.0) * spec.wb * 0.5 + spec.get("wz", 0.0))
		var pivot := Node3D.new()
		pivot.position = pos
		var spin := Node3D.new()
		pivot.add_child(spin)
		var wm := MeshInstance3D.new()
		wm.mesh = wmesh_f if front else wmesh
		if side < 0:
			wm.rotation.y = PI
		spin.add_child(wm)
		root.add_child(pivot)
		wheels.append({"pivot": pivot, "spin": spin, "pos": pos, "r": r, "front": front})
	# nitro flames at the exhausts
	var flames := []
	var fm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	fm.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	fm.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	fm.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	fm.albedo_color = Color(0.4, 0.6, 1.0, 0.9)
	fm.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	var fm2 := fm.duplicate()
	fm2.albedo_color = Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.15, 0.85)
	for ex in spec.exhaust:
		var f := Node3D.new()
		f.position = ex
		var inner := MeshInstance3D.new()
		inner.mesh = Mk.cyl(0.0, 0.11, 0.7, 8)
		inner.material_override = fm
		inner.rotation.x = -PI / 2
		inner.position.z = 0.35
		inner.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
		f.add_child(inner)
		var outer := MeshInstance3D.new()
		outer.mesh = Mk.cyl(0.0, 0.2, 1.3, 8)
		outer.material_override = fm2
		outer.rotation.x = -PI / 2
		outer.position.z = 0.6
		outer.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
		f.add_child(outer)
		f.visible = false
		body.add_child(f)
		flames.append(f)
	return {"root": root, "body": body, "wheels": wheels, "brake": brake, "flames": flames,
		"half_len": spec.len * 0.5, "half_w": spec.track * 0.5 + 0.2, "cam_h": spec.get("cam_h", 1.3)}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ cars
static func _lamp_pair(x: float, y: float, z: float, sx: float, sy: float, sz := 0.06) -> Array:
	return [[Mk.box(sx, sy, sz), Mk.xf(Vector3(x, y, z))], [Mk.box(sx, sy, sz), Mk.xf(Vector3(-x, y, z))]]

	var t := trim()

	# roll cage

	for s in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		parts.append([Mk.cyl(0.05, 0.05, 1.3, 6), Mk.xf(Vector3(s * 0.72, 1.6, 0.75), Vector3(0, 0, 0))])
		parts[-1].append(cage)
		parts.append([Mk.cyl(0.05, 0.05, 1.45, 6), Mk.xf(Vector3(s * 0.7, 1.55, -0.45), Vector3(-0.55, 0, 0)), cage])
		parts.append([Mk.cyl(0.05, 0.05, 1.25, 6), Mk.xf(Vector3(s * 0.72, 2.24, 0.15), Vector3(PI / 2, 0, 0)), cage])
	parts.append([Mk.cyl(0.05, 0.05, 1.44, 6), Mk.xf(Vector3(0, 2.25, 0.75), Vector3(0, 0, PI / 2)), cage])
	parts.append([Mk.cyl(0.05, 0.05, 1.44, 6), Mk.xf(Vector3(0, 2.23, -0.45), Vector3(0, 0, PI / 2)), cage])
	# light bar
	parts.append([Mk.box(1.3, 0.12, 0.14), Mk.xf(Vector3(0, 2.36, -0.45)), t])
	# engine + exhausts
	parts.append([Mk.box(0.9, 0.45, 0.6), Mk.xf(Vector3(0, 1.0, 1.2)), Mk.mat(Color(0.3, 0.3, 0.32), 0.4, 0.8)])
	parts.append([Mk.cyl(0.07, 0.07, 0.7, 8), Mk.xf(Vector3(0.25, 1.05, 1.65), Vector3(PI / 2, 0, 0)), chrome()])
	parts.append([Mk.cyl(0.07, 0.07, 0.7, 8), Mk.xf(Vector3(-0.25, 1.05, 1.65), Vector3(PI / 2, 0, 0)), chrome()])
	# spare tyre
	parts.append([Mk.cyl(0.38, 0.38, 0.26, 14), Mk.xf(Vector3(0, 1.45, 1.55), Vector3(PI / 2, 0, 0)), Mk.mat(Color(0.07, 0.07, 0.08), 0.9)])
	# front bumper
	parts.append([Mk.cyl(0.05, 0.05, 1.3, 6), Mk.xf(Vector3(0, 0.75, -1.85), Vector3(0, 0, PI / 2)), cage])
	var head := []
	for x in [-0.45, -0.15, 0.15, 0.45]:
		head.append([Mk.cyl(0.09, 0.09, 0.08, 10), Mk.xf(Vector3(x, 2.36, -0.53), Vector3(PI / 2, 0, 0))])
	head.append_array(_lamp_pair(0.45, 0.85, -1.78, 0.22, 0.12))
	return {"parts": parts, "head": head, "tail": _lamp_pair(0.5, 0.95, 1.63, 0.16, 0.1), "wr": 0.47, "ww": 0.36, "track": 1.85, "wb": 2.55,
		"rim": Color(0.9, 0.9, 0.92), "chunky": true, "exhaust": [Vector3(0.25, 1.05, 2.0), Vector3(-0.25, 1.05, 2.0)], "len": 3.6, "cam_h": 1.9}

func start_island(m: String) -> void:
	use_world(island)
	_start_common()
	mode = m
	laps = int(G.EVENTS[m].get("laps", 3)) if G.EVENTS.has(m) else 3
	lap = 0
	lap_t = 0.0
	lap_times.clear()
	best_lap_run = 0.0
	cp_next = 1
	splits.clear()
	split_show = 0.0
	finish_order.clear()

	rec_t = 0.0

		state = "run"
		player.frozen = false
		var g0: Array = grid[0]
		player.place(Vector3(g0[0], 0, g0[1]), _yaw_from_heading(float(g0[2])))
		island.set_stars_visible(found, true)
		_banner("FIND 20 STARS!", Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.3), 2.5)
	else:
		var slot := 0 if m == "tt" else 5
		var g: Array = grid[slot]
		player.place(Vector3(g[0], 0, g[1]), _yaw_from_heading(float(g[2])))
		if m == "race":
			var ids := ["rally", "buggy", "drifter", "patrol", "muscle", "falcon"]
			ids.shuffle()
			var k := 0
			for slot_i in 5:
				var gp: Array = grid[slot_i]
				var aid: String = ids[k % ids.size()]
				k += 1
				var sk: float = 0.8 * randf_range(0.93, 1.03) * float(player.def.vmax) / float(G.car_def(aid).vmax)
				sk *= 1.0 - slot_i * 0.02
				var a := _spawn_ai(aid, G.PAINTS[(slot_i * 5 + 3) % G.PAINTS.size()], sk, AI_NAMES[slot_i])
				a.car.place(Vector3(gp[0], 0, gp[1]), _yaw_from_heading(float(gp[2])))
				a.drv.lane = (-1.0 if slot_i % 2 == 0 else 1.0) * randf_range(0.8, 2.6)
				a.drv.idx = int(world.road_near(gp[0], gp[1]).x)
				a.idx = a.drv.idx
				a.prev = a.idx
				a.lap = 0
				a.cp = 1
				a.done = false
				a.base_skill = sk
				a.car.frozen = true
		if m == "tt":
			ghost_play = G.data.ghost if G.data.ghost is PackedFloat32Array else PackedFloat32Array()
			if ghost_play.size() >= 8:
				_make_ghost()

		_setup_bot()

func _yaw_from_heading(h: float) -> float:
	return atan2(-cos(h), -sin(h))

func _spawn_ai(id: String, col: Color, skill: float, nm: String) -> Dictionary:
	var c := CarScript.new()
	add_child(c)
	c.setup(world, fx, id, col, false)
	c.skill = skill
	c.tag = nm
	c.edge_r = player.edge_r
	var d := Driver.new()
	var pts := PackedVector3Array()
	for i in island.RN:
		pts.append(Vector3(island.rx[i], island.rh[i], island.rz[i]))

	d.spacing = island.road_len / island.RN
	d.nitro_ok = true
	var a := {"car": c, "drv": d, "lap": 0, "cp": 1, "idx": 0, "prev": 0, "done": false, "base_skill": skill, "name": nm}
	ais.append(a)
	if not headless:
		c.start_audio()
	return a


func _make_ghost() -> void:
	var gid: String = G.data.get("ghost_car", "rally")
	ghost_car = CarScript.new()
	ghost_car.ghost = true
	add_child(ghost_car)
	ghost_car.setup(world, fx, gid, Color(0.4, 0.8, 1.0), false)
	var gm := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	gm.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	gm.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	gm.albedo_color = Color(0.45, 0.85, 1.0, 0.28)
	gm.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_BACK
	_ghostify(ghost_car, gm)
	ghost_car.shadow.visible = false
	ghost_car.frozen = true


func _ghostify(n: Node, m: Material) -> void:
	if n is MeshInstance3D:
		n.material_override = m
		n.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	for c in n.get_children():
		_ghostify(c, m)


func quit_to_menu() -> void:
	G.save_game()
	player.stop_audio()
	enter_title()


func restart() -> void:
	match mode:
		"race", "tt", "explore":
			start_island(mode)
		"inf":
			start_inf(inf_mode)


func keep_driving() -> void:
	## after a time attack ends: continue in free drive from here
	inf_mode = "free"
	state = "run"
	player.frozen = false
	player.start_audio()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ main loop
func driving() -> bool:
	return mode in ["race", "tt", "explore", "inf"]


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if paused or mode == "":
		return
	var dt := minf(delta, 1.0 / 20.0)
	if slow_t > 0.0:
		slow_t -= delta / maxf(Engine.time_scale, 0.05)
		if slow_t <= 0.0:
			Engine.time_scale = 1.0
	var p0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	if driving():
		if not bot:
			_player_input()
		elif bot_drv != null and state == "run":
			_bot_drive(dt)
		if state != "countdown":
			for a in ais:
				a.drv.drive(a.car, dt)
		var steps := 1 if dt <= 1.0 / 55.0 else 2
		for k in steps:
			tick(dt / steps)
	var p1 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	_camera(delta)
	player.update_visual(dt)
	player.effects(dt)
	player.audio(dt)
	for a in ais:
		a.car.fx_near = a.car.pos.distance_to(cam_pos) < 140.0
		a.car.update_visual(dt)
		a.car.effects(dt)
		a.car.audio(dt)
	if ghost_car != null:
		_ghost_update()
	var p2 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	world.update(dt, cam_pos)
	_ambience()
	var p3 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	sky.update(dt, cam_pos, player.vel)
	fx.update(dt)
	var p4 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	prof[0] += p1 - p0
	prof[1] += p2 - p1
	prof[2] += p3 - p2
	prof[3] += p4 - p3
	prof[4] += 1
	if banner_t > 0.0:
		banner_t -= delta
	if zone_t > 0.0:
		zone_t -= delta
	if split_show > 0.0:
		split_show -= delta
	var i := popups.size() - 1
	while i >= 0:
		popups[i].t -= delta
		if popups[i].t <= 0.0:
			popups.remove_at(i)
		i -= 1
	horn_cool -= delta


func _ambience() -> void:
	if headless:
		return
	var rain_v := 0.55 if sky.raining else 0.0
	var waves_v := 0.0
	if world == island:
		var r := Vector2(cam_pos.x, cam_pos.z).length()
		waves_v = (1.0 - clampf((absf(r - 650.0) - 40.0) / 220.0, 0.0, 1.0)) * 0.5
	elif world.has_method("biome_name"):
		waves_v = 0.0
	for pair in [[amb_rain, rain_v], [amb_waves, waves_v]]:
		var pl: AudioStreamPlayer = pair[0]
		var v: float = pair[1]
		if paused:
			v = 0.0
		if v > 0.01 and not pl.playing:
			pl.play()
		var target := linear_to_db(maxf(v, 0.0001))
		pl.volume_db = lerpf(pl.volume_db, target, 0.05) if pl.volume_db > -60.0 else target
		if v <= 0.01 and pl.playing and pl.volume_db < -50.0:
			pl.stop()


func _player_input() -> void:
	var t := Input.get_action_strength("gas")
	var b := Input.get_action_strength("brake")
	var s := Input.get_action_strength("right") - Input.get_action_strength("left")
	if touch.gas:
		t = 1.0
	if touch.brake:
		b = 1.0
	if touch.left:
		s -= 1.0
	if touch.right:
		s += 1.0
	var hb: bool = Input.is_action_pressed("drift") or touch.drift
	var nos: bool = Input.is_action_pressed("nitro") or touch.nitro
	player.set_input(t, b, clampf(s, -1.0, 1.0), hb, nos)


func _unhandled_input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not driving():
		return
	if e.is_action_pressed("pause"):
		main.toggle_pause()
	elif e.is_action_pressed("camera"):
		cycle_camera()
	elif e.is_action_pressed("reset"):
		reset_car()
	elif e.is_action_pressed("horn"):
		honk()
	elif e.is_action_pressed("lights"):
		player.set_lights(not player.lights_on)


func cycle_camera() -> void:
	cam_mode = (cam_mode + 1) % 4
	G.data.cam = cam_mode
	cam_snap = true
	G.play("click")


func honk() -> void:
	if horn_cool > 0.0:
		return
	horn_cool = 0.6
	var hid := {"buggy": "horn1", "patrol": "horn2", "drifter": "horn1", "muscle": "horn3", "rally": "horn2", "falcon": "horn3"}
	G.play(hid.get(player.car_id, "horn1"))


func reset_car() -> void:
	if state != "run" and state != "countdown":
		return
	var r: Vector2 = world.road_near(player.pos.x, player.pos.z, p_idx)
	var i := int(r.x)
	player.place(world.road_point(i), world.road_yaw(i))
	cam_snap = true
	G.play("click")


func tick(dt: float) -> void:
	if state == "countdown":
		var before := ceili(t_count)
		t_count -= dt
		var after := ceili(t_count)
		if after != before and after >= 1 and after <= 3:
			_banner(str(after), Color(1, 0.9, 0.3), 1.0)
			G.play("beep")
		if t_count <= 0.0:
			state = "run"
			player.frozen = false
			for a in ais:
				a.car.frozen = false
			_banner("GO!", Color(0.4, 1.0, 0.4), 1.0)
			G.play("go")
	player.step(dt)
	for a in ais:
		a.car.step(dt)
	_car_vs_car()
	if state == "run":
		t_run += dt
		_feedback(dt)
		match mode:
			"race", "tt":
				_lap_logic(dt)
			"explore":
				_explore_logic(dt)
			"inf":
				_inf_logic(dt)
	if shake > 0.0:
		shake = maxf(0.0, shake - dt * 2.5)


func _car_vs_car() -> void:
	var cars := [player]
	for a in ais:
		cars.append(a.car)
	for i in cars.size():
		for j in range(i + 1, cars.size()):
			var a = cars[i]
			var b = cars[j]
			var d: Vector3 = b.pos - a.pos
			d.y = 0
			var l := d.length()
			var rr: float = a.half_w + b.half_w + 0.6
			if l < rr and l > 0.01 and absf(a.pos.y - b.pos.y) < 2.0:
				var n := d / l
				var pen := rr - l
				a.pos -= n * pen * 0.5
				b.pos += n * pen * 0.5
				var rel: float = (b.vel - a.vel).dot(n)
				if rel < 0.0:
					var imp := -rel * 0.6
					a.vel -= n * imp
					b.vel += n * imp
					if (a == player or b == player) and imp > 2.5:
						G.play("bump", randf_range(0.9, 1.1), -4.0)
						shake = maxf(shake, minf(imp * 0.04, 0.4))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ island laps
func _crossed(prev: int, cur: int, target: int) -> bool:
	## true if moving forward from prev to cur passes target (road indices, looped)
	var n: int = world.road_count()
	var d := (cur - prev + n) % n
	if d > n / 2:
		return false
	var t := (target - prev + n) % n
	return t > 0 and t <= d


func _prog(lp: int, idx: int, cp: int) -> int:
	var n: int = world.road_count()
	return lp * n + (idx - n if cp == 1 and idx > n / 2 else idx)


func _lap_logic(dt: float) -> void:
	var n: int = world.road_count()
	var cps: Array = island.lay.cps
	var prev := p_idx
	var r: Vector2 = world.road_near(player.pos.x, player.pos.z, p_idx)
	var ni := int(r.x)
	lap_t += dt
	rec_t += dt
	if rec_t >= 0.1:
		rec_t -= 0.1
		ghost_rec.append_array([player.pos.x, player.pos.y, player.pos.z, player.yaw])
	# checkpoints in order
	if cp_next < cps.size() and _crossed(prev, ni, int(cps[cp_next])):
		var best_s: Array = G.data.best_splits
		var k := cp_next - 1
		splits.append(lap_t)
		split_last = lap_t
		split_diff = 0.0
		if k < best_s.size() and float(best_s[k]) > 0.0:
			split_diff = lap_t - float(best_s[k])
		split_show = 3.0
		cp_next += 1
		G.play("gate", 1.0 + cp_next * 0.03)
	# start / finish line
	if _crossed(prev, ni, 0) and lap_t > 5.0:
		if cp_next >= cps.size():
			_lap_done()
		else:
			add_popup("MISSED A CHECKPOINT!", Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.4), 40)
	var d := (ni - prev + n) % n
	if d > n / 2 and player.speed > 5.0:
		wrong_t += dt
	elif d > 0:
		wrong_t = maxf(0.0, wrong_t - dt * 2.0)
	p_idx = ni
	if r.y > 40.0:
		off_t += dt
		if off_t > 6.0:
			off_t = 0.0
			add_popup("BACK TO THE ROAD", Color(1, 1, 1), 34)
			reset_car()
	else:
		off_t = 0.0
	if mode == "race":
		_race_ai(dt)
	if t_run > 900.0:
		_finish(true)


func _lap_done() -> void:
	lap += 1
	var lt := lap_t
	lap_times.append(lt)
	var best: float = float(G.data.best_lap)
	var is_best := best <= 0.0 or lt < best
	if best_lap_run <= 0.0 or lt < best_lap_run:
		best_lap_run = lt
	if is_best:
		G.data.best_lap = lt
		G.data.best_splits = splits.duplicate()
		G.data.ghost = ghost_rec.duplicate()
		G.data.ghost_car = player.car_id
		add_popup("NEW BEST LAP! %s" % G.fmt_time(lt), Color(0.5, 1.0, 0.5), 46)
		G.play("star")
		if mode == "tt" and ghost_car == null and ghost_rec.size() >= 8:
			ghost_play = ghost_rec.duplicate()
			_make_ghost()
		elif mode == "tt":
			ghost_play = ghost_rec.duplicate()
	else:
		add_popup("LAP %s" % G.fmt_time(lt), Color(1, 1, 1), 40)
	lap_t = 0.0
	ghost_rec = PackedFloat32Array()
	rec_t = 0.0
	splits.clear()
	cp_next = 1
	if lap >= laps:
		if mode == "race":
			finish_order.append("YOU")
		_finish(false)
		return
	_banner("LAP %d/%d" % [lap + 1, laps], Color(1, 1, 1), 1.5)
	G.play("lap")
	if lap == laps - 1:
		add_popup("FINAL LAP!", Color(1.0, 0.5, 0.3), 46)


func _ghost_update() -> void:
	if ghost_play.size() < 8 or state != "run":
		ghost_car.visible = state == "countdown"
		if state == "countdown" and ghost_play.size() >= 4:
			ghost_car.pos = Vector3(ghost_play[0], ghost_play[1], ghost_play[2])
			ghost_car.yaw = ghost_play[3]
			ghost_car.update_visual(0.0)
		return
	var f := lap_t / 0.1
	var i := int(f)
	var cnt := ghost_play.size() / 4
	if i >= cnt - 1:
		ghost_car.visible = false
		return
	ghost_car.visible = true
	var t := f - i
	var a := i * 4
	var b := a + 4
	ghost_car.pos = Vector3(lerpf(ghost_play[a], ghost_play[b], t), lerpf(ghost_play[a + 1], ghost_play[b + 1], t), lerpf(ghost_play[a + 2], ghost_play[b + 2], t))
	ghost_car.yaw = lerp_angle(ghost_play[a + 3], ghost_play[b + 3], t)
	ghost_car.n_s = world.normal_at(ghost_car.pos.x, ghost_car.pos.z)
	ghost_car.speed = 20.0
	ghost_car.update_visual(0.016)


func _race_ai(dt: float) -> void:
	var n: int = world.road_count()
	var cps: Array = island.lay.cps
	var p_total := _prog(lap, p_idx, cp_next)
	for a in ais:
		var ai := int(world.road_near(a.car.pos.x, a.car.pos.z, a.idx).x)
		if a.cp < cps.size() and _crossed(a.idx, ai, int(cps[a.cp])):
			a.cp += 1
		if _crossed(a.idx, ai, 0) and a.cp >= cps.size():
			a.lap += 1
			a.cp = 1
			if a.lap >= laps and not a.done:
				a.done = true
				finish_order.append(a.name)
		a.idx = ai
		var a_total := _prog(a.lap, a.idx, a.cp)
		var gap := float(a_total - p_total) * 2.0
		var target: float = a.base_skill * clampf(1.0 - gap / 900.0, 0.72, 1.08)
		if a.done:
			target = 0.6
		a.car.skill = lerpf(a.car.skill, target, 1.0 - exp(-0.5 * dt))
		if a.car.pos.distance_to(Vector3(a.drv.path[a.drv.idx])) > 30.0 or a.car.depth > 1.0:
			a.car.place(world.road_point(a.idx), world.road_yaw(a.idx))
	race_pos = 1
	for a in ais:
		if a.done or _prog(a.lap, a.idx, a.cp) > p_total:
			race_pos += 1


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ explore
func _explore_logic(_dt: float) -> void:
	var stars: Array = island.lay.stars
	for i in stars.size():
		if found.has(i):
			continue
		var n: Node3D = island.stars_nodes[i]
		var d := Vector2(n.position.x - player.pos.x, n.position.z - player.pos.z).length()
		if d < 4.5 and absf(n.position.y - player.pos.y) < 5.0:
			found.append(i)
			n.visible = false
			G.play("star")
			fx.burst(n.position, Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.2), 40, 9.0, 1.0)
			_banner("STAR %d/%d" % [found.size(), stars.size()], Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.25), 2.0)
			if found.size() >= stars.size():
				_finish(false)
	if t_run > 1800.0:
		_finish(true)


func nearest_star() -> Vector3:
	var best := Vector3.ZERO
	var bd := 1e18
	for i in island.stars_nodes.size():
		if found.has(i):
			continue
		var p: Vector3 = island.stars_nodes[i].position
		var d := p.distance_squared_to(player.pos)
		if d < bd:
			bd = d
			best = p
	return best if bd < 1e17 else Vector3.INF


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ unlimited
func _inf_logic(dt: float) -> void:
	var r: Vector2 = world.road_near(player.pos.x, player.pos.z, p_idx)
	p_idx = int(r.x)
	inf_dist = maxf(inf_dist, world.road_distance(p_idx) - world.start_distance())
	var b: String = world.biome_name(player.pos.x, player.pos.z)
	if b != biome:
		if biome != "":
			_banner(b, Color(0.9, 1.0, 0.8), 2.4)
		biome = b
	if inf_mode == "ta":
		t_left -= dt
		if inf_dist >= inf_next_gate:
			inf_gates += 1
			var add := maxf(22.0, 35.0 - inf_gates)
			t_left += add
			inf_next_gate += 1000.0
			G.play("gate", 1.1)
			_banner("+%d s" % int(add), Color(0.5, 1.0, 0.6), 1.6)
			add_popup("%d KM!" % inf_gates, Color(1, 1, 1), 40)
		if t_left <= 0.0:
			t_left = 0.0
			_finish(false)
	if r.y > 45.0:
		off_t += dt
		if off_t > 7.0:
			off_t = 0.0
			add_popup("BACK TO THE ROAD", Color(1, 1, 1), 34)
			reset_car()
	else:
		off_t = 0.0
	if inf_mode == "free":
		if inf_dist > float(G.data.inf_best_free):
			G.data.inf_best_free = inf_dist


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ finish
func _finish(dnf: bool) -> void:
	if state != "run":
		return
	state = "done"
	var stars := 0
	var value = 0
	var best := false
	var key := mode
	match mode:
		"race":
			value = finish_order.size() if not dnf else 6
			stars = 3 if value == 1 else (2 if value == 2 else (1 if value == 3 else 0))
			best = G.set_stars("race", stars)
		"tt":
			value = best_lap_run
			var th: Array = G.EVENTS.tt.stars
			for s in th:
				if not dnf and float(value) > 0.0 and float(value) <= float(s):
					stars += 1
			best = G.set_stars("tt", stars)
		"explore":
			value = found.size()
			var th: Array = G.EVENTS.explore.stars
			for s in th:
				if int(value) >= int(s):
					stars += 1
			if int(value) > int(G.data.explore_found) or (int(value) == int(G.data.explore_found) and (float(G.data.explore_time) <= 0.0 or t_run < float(G.data.explore_time))):
				G.data.explore_found = int(value)
				G.data.explore_time = t_run
				best = true
			G.set_stars("explore", stars)
		"inf":
			value = inf_dist
			key = "inf_ta"
			var th: Array = G.EVENTS.inf_ta.stars
			for s in th:
				if inf_dist / 1000.0 >= float(s):
					stars += 1
			if inf_dist > float(G.data.inf_best_ta):
				G.data.inf_best_ta = inf_dist
				best = true
			G.set_stars("inf_ta", stars)
	G.data.played = int(G.data.played) + 1
	G.save_game()
	result = {"mode": key, "value": value, "stars": stars, "best": best, "dnf": dnf, "laps": lap_times.duplicate(), "time": t_run}
	_banner("FINISH!" if mode != "inf" else "TIME UP!", Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.3), 2.0)
	G.play("finish")
	fx.confetti(player.pos + Vector3(0, 3, 0), 90)
	player.set_input(0, 0.6, 0, false, false)
	if main != null and not headless:
		main.on_done(result)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera
func _camera(dt: float) -> void:
	var c = player
	if mode == "look":
		cam.global_transform = Transform3D(Basis.looking_at(look_at - look_from, Vector3.UP), look_from)
		cam.fov = 55.0
		cam_pos = look_from
		return
	if mode == "showcase":
		var r := showcase.z
		var p: Vector3 = c.pos + Vector3(cos(showcase.x) * r, showcase.y, sin(showcase.x) * r)
		var look: Vector3 = c.pos + Vector3(0, 0.8, 0)
		cam.global_transform = Transform3D(Basis.looking_at(look - p, Vector3.UP), p)
		cam.fov = 40.0
		cam_pos = p
		return
	if mode == "title" or mode == "garage":
		cam_orbit += dt * (0.16 if mode == "title" else 0.28)
		var r := 7.2 if mode == "title" else 5.8
		var hgt := 1.5 if mode == "title" else 1.3
		var center: Vector3 = c.pos + Vector3(0, 0.85, 0)
		var p := center + Vector3(cos(cam_orbit) * r, hgt, sin(cam_orbit) * r)
		var gy: float = world.height(p.x, p.z) + 0.5
		p.y = maxf(p.y, gy)
		var look := center
		if mode == "garage":
			var right := Vector3(sin(cam_orbit), 0, -cos(cam_orbit))
			look = center + right * 1.7 + Vector3(0, -0.05, 0)
		cam.global_transform = Transform3D(Basis.looking_at(look - p, Vector3.UP), p)
		cam.fov = 50.0 if mode == "garage" else 56.0
		cam_pos = p
		return
	var head: Vector3 = c.fwd_flat()
	if cam_mode >= 2:
		var t: Transform3D = c.transform
		var p: Vector3 = t * (Vector3(0, c.cam_h + 0.15, -0.2) if cam_mode == 2 else Vector3(0, 0.62, -c.half_len - 0.05))
		var fw := -t.basis.z
		cam.global_transform = Transform3D(Basis.looking_at(fw, t.basis.y), p)
		cam.fov = lerpf(cam.fov, 72.0 + clampf(c.speed - 10.0, 0.0, 45.0) * 0.3, 1.0 - exp(-3.0 * dt))
		cam_pos = p
		return
	var hv := Vector3(c.vel.x, 0, c.vel.z)
	var want := head
	if hv.length() > 5.0 and c.vf > 0.0:
		want = (head * 0.45 + hv.normalized() * 0.55).normalized()
	if cam_snap:
		cam_dir = want
	else:
		cam_dir = cam_dir.lerp(want, 1.0 - exp(-4.0 * dt))
		if cam_dir.length() < 0.1:
			cam_dir = want
		cam_dir = cam_dir.normalized()
	var size_k: float = clampf(c.cam_h / 1.3, 0.9, 1.5)
	var dist := (6.8 if cam_mode == 0 else 10.5) * size_k
	var hgt := (2.4 if cam_mode == 0 else 3.8) * size_k
	var target: Vector3 = c.pos - cam_dir * dist + Vector3.UP * hgt
	if cam_snap:
		cam_pos = target
		cam_snap = false
	else:
		var kx := 1.0 - exp(-9.0 * dt)
		var ky := 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * dt)
		cam_pos = Vector3(lerpf(cam_pos.x, target.x, kx), lerpf(cam_pos.y, target.y, ky), lerpf(cam_pos.z, target.z, kx))
	var gy: float = world.height(cam_pos.x, cam_pos.z) + 0.8
	if cam_pos.y < gy:
		cam_pos.y = gy
	var look: Vector3 = c.pos + Vector3.UP * (1.1 * size_k) + cam_dir * 3.0
	var p := cam_pos
	if shake > 0.0:
		p += Vector3(randf_range(-1, 1), randf_range(-1, 1), randf_range(-1, 1)) * shake * 0.35
	cam.global_transform = Transform3D(Basis.looking_at(look - p, Vector3.UP), p)
	var fov_t := 66.0 + clampf(c.speed - 10.0, 0.0, 45.0) * 0.33 + (9.0 if c.nitro_on else 0.0)
	cam.fov = lerpf(cam.fov, fov_t, 1.0 - exp(-3.0 * dt))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ test bot
func _setup_bot() -> void:
	bot_drv = Driver.new()
	var pts := PackedVector3Array()
	if mode == "inf":
		bot_drv.loop = false
		return
	for i in island.RN:
		pts.append(Vector3(island.rx[i], island.rh[i], island.rz[i]))
	bot_drv.set_path(pts, true)
	bot_drv.spacing = island.road_len / island.RN
	bot_drv.idx = p_idx
	bot_drv.nitro_ok = true


func _bot_drive(dt: float) -> void:
	if state != "run" or bot_drv == null:
		player.set_input(0, 0, 0, false, false)
		return
	if mode == "explore":
		var tgt := nearest_star()
		if tgt == Vector3.INF:
			player.set_input(0, 1, 0, false, false)
			return
		var f: Vector3 = player.fwd_flat()
		var to: Vector3 = tgt - player.pos
		to.y = 0
		var ang := atan2(f.cross(to).y, f.dot(to))
		player.set_input(1.0 if absf(ang) < 1.2 else 0.5, 0.0, clampf(-ang * 2.0, -1, 1), false, false)
		return
	if mode == "inf":
		# rebuild a short path from the endless road ahead every frame
		var pts := PackedVector3Array()
		for k in 120:
			pts.append(world.road_point(p_idx + k))
		bot_drv.path = pts
		bot_drv.idx = 0
		bot_drv.loop = false
		bot_drv.nitro_ok = true
	bot_drv.drive(player, dt)

static func _road_frame(w, i: int) -> Array:
	var p: Vector3 = w.road_point(i)
	var d: Vector2 = w.road_dir(i)
	var fw := Vector3(d.x, 0, d.y)
	var rt := Vector3(-d.y, 0, d.x)
	return [p, fw, rt, atan2(-d.x, -d.y)]

static func _checkpoints(w, root: Node3D) -> void:
	var cps: Array = w.lay.cps
	for ci in range(1, cps.size()):
		var f := _road_frame(w, int(cps[ci]))
		var n := Node3D.new()
		n.position = f[0]
		n.rotation.y = f[3]
		root.add_child(n)
		var span: float = w.hw * 2.0 + 2.4
		var parts := []
		var col := V(Color(0.1, 0.75, 0.8), 0.55)
		var stripe := V(Color(1, 1, 1), 0.55)
		# inflatable arch: tube along a half-rounded rectangle
		var pts := []
		var h := 6.0
		for k in 25:
			var t := float(k) / 24.0
			var a := PI * t
			var x := -cos(a) * span * 0.5
			var y := sin(a) * h if t > 0.0 and t < 1.0 else 0.0
			y = maxf(y, 0.0)
			if t < 0.15:
				y = t / 0.15 * sin(PI * 0.15) * h
			pts.append(Vector3(x, minf(y + 0.0, h), 0))
		pts[0] = Vector3(-span * 0.5, -0.3, 0)
		pts[24] = Vector3(span * 0.5, -0.3, 0)
		for k in 24:
			var a: Vector3 = pts[k]
			var b: Vector3 = pts[k + 1]
			var c := (a + b) * 0.5
			var l := a.distance_to(b)
			var bas := PQ.basis_y(b - a)
			parts.append([Mk.cyl(0.55, 0.55, l + 0.1, 12), Transform3D(bas, c), stripe if k % 4 == 1 else col])
		mesh_node(n, parts, Transform3D())
		label(n, "CHECKPOINT %d" % ci, Vector3(0, h + 0.1, -0.6), 72, Color(1, 1, 1), PI)
		for s: float in [-1.0, 1.0]:
			var lp: Vector3 = f[0] + f[2] * s * span * 0.5
			w.add_circle(lp.x, lp.z, 0.6, f[0].y + 6.0)


static func _barriers(w, root: Node3D) -> void:

		var tz := sin(hd)
		for k: float in [-0.56, 0.56]:

			var y: float = w.height(px, pz)
			Veg.pack(xfs, Vector3(px, y, pz), hd, 1.0, Color(1, 1, 1), 0.0)

	mm.use_custom_data = true

	mm.buffer = xfs
	var mmi := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
	mmi.multimesh = mm
	mmi.visibility_range_end = 400.0
	root.add_child(mmi)

static func _pier(w, root: Node3D) -> void:
	# wooden jetty from the beach south of the start, with two boats
	var f := _road_frame(w, int(w.RN * 0.03))
	var p: Vector3 = f[0]
	var out: Vector3 = f[2]  # right of the road = toward the sea on the south coast
	if w.height(p.x + out.x * 40.0, p.z + out.z * 40.0) > w.height(p.x - out.x * 40.0, p.z - out.z * 40.0):
		out = -out
	var start: Vector3 = p + out * 14.0
	var L := 70.0
	var yaw := atan2(out.x, out.z)
	var n := Node3D.new()
	n.position = Vector3(start.x, 0, start.z)
	n.rotation.y = yaw
	root.add_child(n)
	var parts := []
	var wood := V(Color(0.55, 0.42, 0.3), 0.9)
	var wood2 := V(Color(0.47, 0.36, 0.26), 0.9)
	var k := 0
	var z := 0.0
	while z < L:
		parts.append([Mk.box(3.2, 0.12, 0.4), Mk.xf(Vector3(0, 1.4, z)), wood if k % 2 == 0 else wood2])
		z += 0.45
		k += 1
	for zz in range(0, int(L), 5):
		for s: float in [-1.5, 1.5]:
			parts.append([Mk.cyl(0.14, 0.14, 6.0, 6), Mk.xf(Vector3(s, -1.5, zz)), wood2])
	for s: float in [-1.6, 1.6]:
		parts.append([Mk.box(0.1, 0.1, L), Mk.xf(Vector3(s, 2.2, L * 0.5)), wood])
	mesh_node(n, parts, Transform3D())
	for b in 2:
		var bp := []
		var hull: Color = [Color(0.95, 0.95, 0.95), Color(0.15, 0.55, 0.8)][b]
		bp.append([Mk.loft([[-2.6, 0.2, 0.9, 0.05, 0.3, 0.6], [-1.6, 0.0, 1.0, 0.6, 0.85, 0.5], [1.4, 0.0, 1.0, 0.75, 0.9, 0.4], [2.5, 0.1, 1.0, 0.7, 0.85, 0.4]], 12), Mk.xf(Vector3.ZERO), V(hull, 0.4)])
		bp.append([Mk.box(1.3, 0.05, 3.6), Mk.xf(Vector3(0, 0.98, 0.2)), V(Color(0.6, 0.48, 0.34), 0.8)])
		bp.append([Mk.box(1.1, 0.8, 1.2), Mk.xf(Vector3(0, 1.4, 0.6)), V(Color(0.95, 0.95, 0.95), 0.4)])
		var boat := mesh_node(n, bp, Transform3D(Basis(Vector3.UP, 0.1), Vector3(3.8 * (1 if b == 0 else -1), -0.3, 30.0 + b * 22.0)))
		boat.set_meta("bob", b)

static func update_smoke(_w, dt: float) -> void:
	if smoke_mm == null:

		var p: Dictionary = smoke_p[i]
		p.t += dt
		if p.t > 30.0:

		var pos := smoke_src + Vector3(p.o.x + t * 60.0, t * 140.0, p.o.y + t * 25.0)

## Headless self test: a bot plays each mode and reports results and timings.
## Run: godot --headless --path . --fixed-fps 30 -- --selftest [--only=race,tt,explore,inf]

var main
var steps := []
var cur := -1
var t := 0.0
var frames := 0
var ms_acc := 0.0
var ms_max := 0.0
var last_us := 0


func _ready() -> void:
	var only := ""
	for a in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if a.begins_with("--only="):
			only = a.substr(7)
	for s in ["race", "tt", "explore", "inf"]:
		if only == "" or s in only.split(","):
			steps.append(s)
	main.game.bot = true
	_next()


func _next() -> void:
	cur += 1
	t = 0.0
	frames = 0
	ms_acc = 0.0
	ms_max = 0.0
	if cur >= steps.size():
		print("SELFTEST_DONE")
		get_tree().quit()
		return
	var s: String = steps[cur]
	print("--- ", s)
	match s:
		"race", "tt", "explore":
			main.game.start_island(s)
		"inf":
			main.game.start_inf("ta")
	last_us = Time.get_ticks_usec()


func _process(dt: float) -> void:
	if cur < 0 or cur >= steps.size():
		return
	var now := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	var ms := (now - last_us) / 1000.0
	last_us = now
	if frames > 2:
		ms_acc += ms
		ms_max = maxf(ms_max, ms)
	frames += 1
	t += dt
	var g = main.game
	var s: String = steps[cur]
	var limit: float = {"race": 420.0, "tt": 260.0, "explore": 300.0, "inf": 200.0}[s]
	if int(t) % 30 == 0 and int(t - dt) % 30 != 0:
		print("  t=%d mode=%s state=%s lap=%d pos=%d idx=%d speed=%.1f dist=%.0f found=%d" % [int(t), g.mode, g.state, g.lap, g.race_pos, g.p_idx, g.player.speed, g.inf_dist, g.found.size()])
	if g.state == "done" or t > limit:
		print("  RESULT ", g.result if not g.result.is_empty() else "timeout")
		if s in ["race", "tt"]:
			print("  laps ", g.lap_times, " best ", g.best_lap_run)
		if s == "race":
			print("  order ", g.finish_order)
		if s == "inf":
			print("  inf dist %.0f m, gates %d, chunks %d" % [g.inf_dist, g.inf_gates, g.world.terrain.built_count])
			print("  max us: terrain %d, props %d, veg cells %d, veg near %d" % g.world.pmax)
			print("  terrain stage max us: mesh %d, water %d, grass %d, job overrun %d, plan %d" % g.world.terrain.smax)
		print("  frames %d avg %.2f ms max %.1f ms" % [frames, ms_acc / maxi(frames - 3, 1), ms_max])
		var pr: Array = g.prof
		var nf := maxi(1, int(pr[4]))
		print("  per frame: physics %.2f ms, visuals %.2f ms, world %.2f ms, sky+fx %.2f ms" % [pr[0] / 1000.0 / nf, pr[1] / 1000.0 / nf, pr[2] / 1000.0 / nf, pr[3] / 1000.0 / nf])
		g.prof = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
		_next()

"""High-resolution textures for the hero Sand Buggy -> ../tex/car_*.png.bin
car_decals: sticker atlas 2048x1024 (RGBA)        car_tyre: sidewall lettering ring 2048x256
car_carbon: carbon weave 512 (tileable)           car_plate_n: diamond plate normal map 512 (tileable)
car_fabric: seat fabric 512 (tileable)            car_gauges: 3 gauge faces + GPS screen 1024x256
car_flake: metal-flake noise 256 (tileable)       car_tread_n: knobby rubber normal 256 (tileable)
"""
import io, os, math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "tex")
FONT = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "fonts", "title.ttf")
FONT_B = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "fonts", "bold.ttf")
FONT_D = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "fonts", "digits.ttf")
PREVIEW = os.environ.get("PREVIEW_DIR")
rng = np.random.default_rng(3)


def save(name, img):
    b = io.BytesIO()
    img.save(b, "PNG", optimize=True)
    open(os.path.join(OUT, name + ".png.bin"), "wb").write(b.getvalue())
    if PREVIEW:
        img.save(os.path.join(PREVIEW, name + ".png"))


def font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)


def text_c(d, box, s, f, fill, stroke=0, stroke_fill=None):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
    bb = d.textbbox((0, 0), s, font=f, stroke_width=stroke)
    w, h = bb[2] - bb[0], bb[3] - bb[1]
    d.text(((x0 + x1 - w) / 2 - bb[0], (y0 + y1 - h) / 2 - bb[1]), s, font=f, fill=fill, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_fill=stroke_fill)


def tile_noise(n, falloff, seed):
    r = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    f = np.fft.fftfreq(n)[:, None] ** 2 + np.fft.fftfreq(n)[None, :] ** 2
    f[0, 0] = 1
    spec = (r.normal(size=(n, n)) + 1j * r.normal(size=(n, n))) / f ** (falloff / 2)
    spec[0, 0] = 0
    x = np.real(np.fft.ifft2(spec))
    return (x - x.mean()) / (x.std() + 1e-9)


def normal_from_height(h, strength):
    gx = (np.roll(h, -1, 1) - np.roll(h, 1, 1)) * 0.5
    gy = (np.roll(h, -1, 0) - np.roll(h, 1, 0)) * 0.5
    nx, ny, nz = -gx * strength, -gy * strength, np.ones_like(h)
    ln = np.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz)
    n = np.stack([nx / ln, ny / ln, nz / ln], -1) * 0.5 + 0.5
    return Image.fromarray((n * 255).round().astype(np.uint8), "RGB")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ carbon weave 512
N = 512
yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:N, 0:N] / N
cells = 16
cx = (xx * cells) % 1.0
cy = (yy * cells) % 1.0
checker = ((np.floor(xx * cells) + np.floor(yy * cells)) % 2).astype(bool)
weave = np.where(checker, np.sin(cx * np.pi) ** 0.6, np.sin(cy * np.pi) ** 0.6)
fib = np.where(checker, np.sin(cy * np.pi * 10) * 0.08, np.sin(cx * np.pi * 10) * 0.08)
v = 0.08 + 0.22 * weave + fib
carbon = np.stack([v, v * 1.02, v * 1.08], -1)
save("car_carbon", Image.fromarray((np.clip(carbon, 0, 1) * 255).astype(np.uint8), "RGB"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ diamond plate normal 512
h = np.zeros((N, N))
rep = 8
for i in range(rep):

        cyp = (j + 0.5) / rep

        f = min(len(x) // 4, int(0.004 * SR))

            x[:f] *= np.linspace(0, 1, f)
            x[-f:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, f)
    d = (np.clip(x, -1, 1) * 32767).astype(np.int16)
    with wave.open(os.path.join(OUT, name + ".wav"), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1)
        w.setsampwidth(2)
        w.setframerate(SR)
        w.writeframes(d.tobytes())

    b, a = butter(order, min(fc, SR * 0.45) / (SR / 2), "low")

def ks_pluck(f, d, bright=0.6, decay=0.996):

        v = ring[i % p]
        out[i] = v

def save(name, arr, mode):

def tile_noise(n, falloff, seed):
    r = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    f = np.fft.fftfreq(n)[:, None] ** 2 + np.fft.fftfreq(n)[None, :] ** 2
    f[0, 0] = 1
    spec = (r.normal(size=(n, n)) + 1j * r.normal(size=(n, n))) / f ** (falloff / 2)
    spec[0, 0] = 0
    x = np.real(np.fft.ifft2(spec))
    return (x - x.mean()) / (x.std() + 1e-9)


def norm01(x):
    return (x - x.min()) / (x.max() - x.min() + 1e-9)


def normal_map(h, strength):
    gx = (np.roll(h, -1, 1) - np.roll(h, 1, 1)) * 0.5
    gy = (np.roll(h, -1, 0) - np.roll(h, 1, 0)) * 0.5
    nx, ny, nz = -gx * strength, -gy * strength, np.ones_like(gx)
    ln = np.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz)
    return ((np.stack([nx / ln, ny / ln, nz / ln], -1) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 255).round().astype(np.uint8)


def cells(n, count, seed):

    rep = np.concatenate([pts + [dx, dy] for dx in (-1, 0, 1) for dy in (-1, 0, 1)])
    tree = cKDTree(rep)
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:n, 0:n] / n
    d, idx = tree.query(np.stack([xx.ravel(), yy.ravel()], 1), k=2)
    return d[:, 0].reshape(n, n), d[:, 1].reshape(n, n), (idx[:, 0] % count).reshape(n, n)

def leaf_poly(cx, cy, length, width, ang, steps=10):

"""Load the exported web build in headless Chromium, take screenshots, report console errors.
usage: python3 webtest.py <outdir> [script]  script = semicolon list of actions:
  wait:ms | tap:x,y (fractions of viewport) | shot:name | size:w,h | hold:x,y,ms | swipe:x1,y1,x2,y2
"""
import sys, os, subprocess, time, socket
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

out = sys.argv[1]
script = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "wait:9000;shot:title"
W, H = int(os.environ.get("TW", "960")), int(os.environ.get("TH", "640"))
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)


def free_port():
    s = socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); p = s.getsockname()[1]; s.close(); return p


port = free_port()
srv = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "http.server", str(port), "--bind", "127.0.0.1"], cwd="/home/claude/ccr/build",
                       stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
time.sleep(0.8)
errors = []
try:
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        b = p.chromium.launch(args=["--no-proxy-server", "--use-angle=swiftshader", "--enable-unsafe-swiftshader", "--ignore-gpu-blocklist",
                                    "--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required"])
        ctx = b.new_context(viewport={"width": W, "height": H}, device_scale_factor=1, has_touch=False)
        pg = ctx.new_page()
        pg.set_default_timeout(180000)
        pg.on("console", lambda m: errors.append(f"{m.type}: {m.text}") if m.type in ("error", "warning") or "ERROR" in m.text else None)
        pg.on("pageerror", lambda e: errors.append(f"pageerror: {e}"))
        pg.goto(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/index.html")
        for act in script.split(";"):
            act = act.strip()
            if not act:
                continue
            k, _, v = act.partition(":")
            if k == "wait":
                pg.wait_for_timeout(int(v))
            elif k == "tap":
                x, y = [float(a) for a in v.split(",")]
                vw = pg.viewport_size
                pg.mouse.click(x * vw["width"], y * vw["height"])
            elif k == "hold":
                x, y, ms = [float(a) for a in v.split(",")]
                vw = pg.viewport_size
                pg.mouse.move(x * vw["width"], y * vw["height"]); pg.mouse.down(); pg.wait_for_timeout(int(ms)); pg.mouse.up()
            elif k == "swipe":
                x1, y1, x2, y2 = [float(a) for a in v.split(",")]
                vw = pg.viewport_size
                pg.mouse.move(x1 * vw["width"], y1 * vw["height"]); pg.mouse.down()
                for s in range(1, 11):
                    f = s / 10
                    pg.mouse.move((x1 + (x2 - x1) * f) * vw["width"], (y1 + (y2 - y1) * f) * vw["height"])
                    pg.wait_for_timeout(16)
                pg.mouse.up()
            elif k == "shot":
                t0 = time.time()
                pg.screenshot(path=os.path.join(out, v + ".png"))
                print("shot", v, "took %.1fs" % (time.time() - t0))
            elif k == "key":
                pg.keyboard.press(v)
            elif k == "keydown":
                pg.keyboard.down(v)
            elif k == "keyup":
                pg.keyboard.up(v)
            elif k == "fps":
                print("fps", pg.evaluate("() => new Promise(r => { let n = 0; const t0 = performance.now(); function f() { n++; if (performance.now() - t0 < 3000) requestAnimationFrame(f); else r(n / ((performance.now() - t0) / 1000)); } requestAnimationFrame(f); })"))
            elif k == "goto":
                pg.goto(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/index.html" + v)
                pg.reload()
            elif k == "size":
                w, h = [int(a) for a in v.split(",")]
                pg.set_viewport_size({"width": w, "height": h})
        b.close()
finally:
    srv.terminate()
print("console issues:", len(errors))
for e in errors[:40]:
    print(" ", e[:300])
